finding.detail: Before this guard, a long structurally valid receipt could close a VAJRA handoff even when its relation explicitly said the evidence was insufficient or did not support/refute a conclusion. v0.3.2 preserves such returns as audited INDETERMINATE_RELATION rejections and leaves the branch open.

gut.summarySample: [CONTRADICTION->VAJRA] 主動尋找最小反例與破壞條件 · [CONTRADICTION->VAJRA] 主動尋找最小反例與破壞條件：針對本輪 EMPIRICAL 命題（ref:20708907; clause:bf2b3177），哪個前提最可能先失效？ · [CLAIM->DROPLET] EMPIRICAL · [EVIDENCE_OR_PROVENANCE->MUTHER] 要求可追溯證據並區分支持與缺席證據 · [CLAIM->DROPLET] 命題成立條件需要顯式化 · [EVIDENCE_OR_PROVENANCE->MUTHER] 資料品質、測量方式與來源獨立性需要檢查 · [CLAIM->DROPLET] Preferred organ is a routing request

boundary: PASS certifies only a bounded lexical anti-false-certainty guard over handoff receipt relations. It does not semantically judge relevance, evidence quality, truth, or whether an uncertain source should outweigh a supporting source.
